children: Revolut founder and CEO Nik Storonsky confirmed on Thursday that the financial technology firm is planning a dual stock market listing in New York and London, in an interview with French newspaper Les Echos.
Reuters could not verify the report. Revolut did not immediately reply to a request for comment.
